audit.head: 8d928d6d913d61e51052a8c52f2b665cac332c03
audit.prior_electron_smoke: User-reported prior PASS; not rerun and not proof of each audited workflow.
audit.published_cloud_rules: User-reported v1.0.0 publication; no remote fetch/apply.

assessment.next_goal: G-A: Workspace data safety and scope ownership
assessment.next_goal_reason: Current ordinary project deletion violates preservation consent; draft navigation/edit ownership can overwrite unsent content. Fix actual Inbox identity before relocation and validate those boundaries together.
assessment.parallel_small_goal: G-B: Narrow ProviderFailureV2 credential redaction repair

findings.title: Project deletion contradicts the promise to preserve conversations
findings.user_visible_scenario: Delete a user project after confirming that its chats will move to Inbox.
findings.broken_or_incomplete_loop: UI confirmation promises relocation; V2 IPC/repository directly deletes project; enforced FKs cascade through conversations/messages and generation records.

evidence.description: Physical cascade test does not assert UI preservation

findings.minimal_repair_direction: Close the current preservation contract with atomic relocation to the actual template-owning project before deletion, followed by refresh; if the owner chooses physical deletion, explicitly change consent/counts and test that product contract. This audit does not choose destructive semantics.

existing_tests.assessment: Schema tests intentionally cover physical cascade; IPC tests verify deletion/drain but never the preservation promise.

findings.recommended_validation: Isolated DB+IPC project with chats/messages/drafts; assert preservation and actual Inbox ownership, then matching confirmation and active-scope refresh.

findings.title: Conversation navigation can overwrite the destination draft
findings.user_visible_scenario: Chat A has text and chat B a different saved draft; select B.
findings.broken_or_incomplete_loop: Active ID changes before a synchronous watcher calls unscoped flush. Flush captures old visible text against new active scope/revision, writes B, then restores B.

evidence.description: Previous scope exists but flush has no previous-scope input
Reads current active scope and visible text

findings.minimal_repair_direction: Capture immutable old scope/content and flush before navigation; guard restores by request/scope identity. CAS alone cannot prevent a correct-revision write to the wrong intended chat.

existing_tests.assessment: No two-conversation distinct-draft navigation assertion found in App fixtures.

findings.recommended_validation: Hold IPC responses; navigate A→B→A with distinct drafts and attachments, verify both persisted texts and UI identities.

findings.title: Edit session crosses conversations and is not restored after restart
findings.user_visible_scenario: Edit A, navigate to B, then cancel/submit; reopen a persisted edit draft after restart.
findings.broken_or_incomplete_loop: Global edit session survives navigation; submit uses old question in new branch, cancel assigns old previous draft into current chat; persisted edit mode restores without edit-session reconstruction.

evidence.description: Interaction lock only covers attachment confirmation
Cancel restores prior text into active visible draft
Draft mode restored but session not reconstructed

findings.minimal_repair_direction: Scope edit state and restore/cancel effects to conversation/branch, guard navigation/late responses, and rehydrate persisted edit semantics. Decide cancel-after-restart prior-snapshot contract explicitly.

existing_tests.assessment: Regenerate/retry and composer fixtures do not cover edit→navigate→cancel or restart with edit draft.

findings.recommended_validation: Isolated A/B edit navigation/cancel and restart tests; no foreign draft assignment, correct edit controls/question identity.

findings.title: Credential sanitizer misses labels with URLs and provider header keys
findings.user_visible_scenario: A provider failure echoes a credential beside a safe URL or under x-api-key/x-goog-api-key; user opens/copies safe details.
findings.broken_or_incomplete_loop: URL presence suppresses credential-label redaction; structured header names are omitted; matched values can survive persisted error facts and safe UI projections.
findings.minimal_repair_direction: Run credential-label redaction independently of ordinary URL preservation; cover provider header names recursively and add composition cases. Preserve bounded useful nonsecret facts. No actual historical credential leak was established.

existing_tests.assessment: Existing Authorization/proxy/query tests miss label+safe URL and nested provider header keys; dummy probe confirms both holes.

findings.recommended_validation: Pure-function regressions for label-only, label+URL, nested x-api-key/x-goog-api-key, safe URLs and authorization/query controls; persisted/details projection retains only redacted dummy values.

findings.title: The newest project can become a false Inbox
findings.user_visible_scenario: Create/rename another project, refresh projects or restart.
findings.broken_or_incomplete_loop: ensure-default returns most recently updated project ID even when existing template belongs elsewhere; UI protection/Inbox and backend/new-chat destination diverge.
findings.minimal_repair_direction: Return the stored template's actual project ID and assert consistency with its conversation; consume that authoritative identity in UI.

existing_tests.assessment: Current UI fixtures supply a single stable default; no second-project ensure-default identity assertion found.

findings.recommended_validation: Create/rename two projects in isolated state; defaultProjectId always equals stored template conversation project; New and delete protection agree.

findings.title: Web-search UI emits fields native contracts reject
findings.user_visible_scenario: Enable native web search on Anthropic or Gemini GenerateContent and send using ordinary settings.
findings.broken_or_incomplete_loop: Universal search builder adds maxResults/context/optional engine; provider compiler rejects unsupported/unencoded fields although native search exists.

evidence.description: Always emits maxResults/searchContextSize except interactions image
Supports native search but not context/engine

findings.minimal_repair_direction: Make controls/semantic emission provider-aware and omit unsupported fields. Preserve strict backend contracts rather than silently widening them.

existing_tests.assessment: Editor and OpenRouter send-event mocks miss native UI→compiler/IPC closure; backend validation can reject without exposing the UI defect.

findings.recommended_validation: Compile actual UI-built semantics through Anthropic/Gemini/Responses prepared compilers with synthetic capabilities and mocked transport; assert supported-only fields and no paid requests.

findings.title: Ready DOCX PDF cannot be selected
findings.user_visible_scenario: Managed LibreOffice successfully converts DOCX; choose its ready PDF option.
findings.broken_or_incomplete_loop: Output is persisted under DOCX contract but every PDF selection queries HTML contract and raises OPTION_UNAVAILABLE.
findings.minimal_repair_direction: Bind the immutable output using the contract that produced the option; regression test generation→select→effective revision→send.

existing_tests.assessment: Packaged/live-installed DOCX Electron smokes would catch selection failure with valid runtime/build prerequisites. Default shell Markdown smoke and service availability/adapter tests do not. No current specialized result claimed.

findings.recommended_validation: Isolated DOCX service/IPC selection test plus the existing specialized temporary-profile smoke when its runtime prerequisites are available.

findings.title: Active conversation deletion leaves stale IDs and transcript
findings.user_visible_scenario: Delete the open chat, including through bulk deletion, then continue typing/sending.
findings.broken_or_incomplete_loop: Backend deletion/list refresh succeeds; active IDs are not cleared; replacement selection happens only when ID is null; reload fails before replacing old transcript.

evidence.description: Bulk delete also leaves active IDs
Replacement only when no active ID

findings.minimal_repair_direction: After successful active deletion rebind/clear scope, transcript/cache and draft to a valid survivor or New template; coordinate with draft ownership repairs.

existing_tests.assessment: Repository/IPC deletion tests cover data mutations, not active renderer scope closure.

findings.recommended_validation: Single/bulk active deletion with two chats: valid replacement IDs, no deleted transcript/send target, correct destination draft.

findings.title: Rules/priority saves leave controls and Inspector stale
findings.user_visible_scenario: Resolve a conflict in Rules/Source Priority and return to the unchanged active model/Inspector.
findings.broken_or_incomplete_loop: Mutation updates local panel/config but emits no semantic invalidation; active capability watcher only tracks route/model/chat/image mode; Inspector persists old read. Stale-send safety fallback may refresh only after rejection.

evidence.description: Refresh key omits Rules/source priority mutation
Existing safe stale-send refresh, no automatic resubmit

findings.minimal_repair_direction: Connect successful semantic mutations to authoritative current projection/re-resolution and Inspector refresh. Keep frozen retry snapshots and explicit resubmit guard.

existing_tests.assessment: Existing tests catch stale send and safely refresh without auto-resubmit; they do not catch proactive same-route controls/Inspector refresh after save.

findings.recommended_validation: Save rule/priority with same model selected; refreshed winner/revision/control availability before send, Inspector reloads; retry remains frozen and no auto-send.

findings.title: Search hits outside current transcript cannot be located
findings.user_visible_scenario: Click a match older than latest 50 messages or on a different branch.
findings.broken_or_incomplete_loop: Search closes, default/latest branch page loads, focus checks loaded messages only and returns false; caller ignores it; hit lacks branch identity.
findings.minimal_repair_direction: Resolve eligible branch and load anchored/earlier pages before focus; report unavailable target with recovery. Reuse existing navigation helpers where correct.

existing_tests.assessment: Search repo indexing/query/rebuild tests pass without testing hit→branch/page→highlight closure.

findings.recommended_validation: Search and open an older-than-50 hit and alternate-branch hit; target is visible/highlighted or a clear recoverable failure appears.

findings.title: Initial workspace failure hides the error and recovery entry
findings.user_visible_scenario: First workspace/bootstrap IPC fails before active conversation assignment.
findings.broken_or_incomplete_loop: Startup stores loadError; workspaceMode none hides sole error/settings topbar; list refresh with no projects does not retry full initialization.
findings.minimal_repair_direction: Render root loading/error/retry and settings independently of active conversation; rerun bounded initialization rather than treating failure as empty workspace.

existing_tests.assessment: Current nominal startup fixtures and client error propagation tests do not render App under rejected initial reads.

findings.recommended_validation: Reject first workspace read/missing bridge in isolated UI fixture; visible error and settings, retry successfully initializes without real profile.

findings.title: Cloud check failures look like successful no updates
findings.user_visible_scenario: Click Check Updates offline, on server failure or invalid publication.
findings.broken_or_incomplete_loop: Backend returns nonthrowing failed result; UI ignores it, reload clears error, persisted last failure/check metadata is omitted.
findings.minimal_repair_direction: Handle result.ok and show localized failure/retry with last check and retained-good state; do not change real Cloud state during validation.

existing_tests.assessment: Backend tests deliberately cover nonthrowing failures; UI success-only mocks miss the discarded result.

findings.recommended_validation: UI fixture returns failed check while prior release exists/no release exists; clear failure feedback, retained state and safe retry, no publication/apply.

findings.title: Enter on an action button invokes model selection
findings.user_visible_scenario: Keyboard-focus Close/Favorite/detail/filter while a model is active, then press Enter.
findings.broken_or_incomplete_loop: Ancestor handles every non-input Enter, prevents button action and calls persisted model selection instead.
findings.minimal_repair_direction: Own keyboard model navigation within its list/combobox; let native buttons execute their focused action.

existing_tests.assessment: One dialog-root Enter test exists, but no focused action-button Enter test.

findings.recommended_validation: Keyboard Close/Favorite/filter/detail activation must never invoke selection; Enter on model item selects deliberately.

findings.title: Provider catalog override reports Saved but is denied by IPC
findings.user_visible_scenario: Enable provider override in Settings, save and reopen/restart.
findings.broken_or_incomplete_loop: Client uses providerCatalog.<provider>.policyV2 while IPC allows root keys only; read undefined/write false ignored; startup reads same denied key.
findings.minimal_repair_direction: Provide narrow validated catalog-policy authority/known keys and honor mutation ack before success/touched reset; preserve credential boundaries.

existing_tests.assessment: Permissive UI fake store and direct startup fake values bypass exact production key validation.

findings.recommended_validation: Focused isolated UI/IPC regression for the described scenario.

findings.title: Preference persistence failure still reports success
findings.user_visible_scenario: A retained settings write is rejected or IPC fails; user sees updated UI/Saved but restart restores old settings.
findings.broken_or_incomplete_loop: Shared root preference writer ignores store-set false; Settings ignores boolean errors and emits live updates/success.
findings.minimal_repair_direction: Propagate strict persistence ack/errors and stop success events/touched clearing; retain edits with explicit retry. Root preference key is allowed: this is not the provider dot-key issue.

existing_tests.assessment: Client tests accept undefined ack; UI mocks do not inject false/rejection across real bridge.

findings.recommended_validation: Focused isolated UI/IPC regression for the described scenario.

findings.title: Exposed legacy settings have no current runtime effect
findings.user_visible_scenario: Toggle require_parameters or network experiment switches, save/restart and expect described request/startup changes.
findings.broken_or_incomplete_loop: require_parameters uses removed dbBridge and no V2 compiler consumer; experiment flags persist but current Electron transport/startup never reads them and runtime-info bridge is absent.

evidence.description: Closed V2 request omits provider option

findings.minimal_repair_direction: Hide/disable unsupported controls and correct copy within frozen support; do not revive legacy bridge or add new semantics as cleanup.

existing_tests.assessment: Settings test installs obsolete dbBridge and asserts its call; no experiment behavior test found.

findings.recommended_validation: Focused isolated UI/IPC regression for the described scenario.

findings.title: Generic User Rules cannot be authored in the GUI
findings.user_visible_scenario: Correct tools/vision/token facts from Inspector using GUI.
findings.broken_or_incomplete_loop: Add creates only reasoning.support with one native model; editor cannot change assertion value/path/selector despite generic backend and JSON import.
findings.minimal_repair_direction: Typed path/value/subject/selector authoring over existing generic APIs; retain durable drafts and guarded selectors. Import alternative makes this partial GUI scope, not missing backend.

existing_tests.assessment: Generic service tests and configured-toggle mocks omit multi-path GUI author/edit.

findings.recommended_validation: Focused isolated UI/IPC regression for the described scenario.

findings.title: Older async Inspector reads can overwrite newer selection
findings.user_visible_scenario: Choose A then B quickly or switch subject during evidence/raw read.
findings.broken_or_incomplete_loop: No latest-request identity guard; delayed A response overwrites B facts/evidence while B is selected.
findings.minimal_repair_direction: Guard all subject/evidence/raw/search reads with identity/serial or cancellation and clear stale view at selection change.

existing_tests.assessment: Immediate mocks do not exercise held/reordered subject and evidence responses.

findings.recommended_validation: Focused isolated UI/IPC regression for the described scenario.

findings.title: HTML/CSV format conversions send unchanged source
findings.user_visible_scenario: Choose Markdown for HTML or table Markdown for CSV/TSV.
findings.broken_or_incomplete_loop: All textual targets marked available; transform returns source unchanged except code fences; output is mislabeled text/markdown and used for send.
findings.minimal_repair_direction: Reviewed format-specific transforms for existing targets or block false semantic choices. Preserve deliberate source/code choices; no office/OCR expansion.

existing_tests.assessment: Markdown input/mock output tests cannot detect identity conversion; assert HTML stripping and CSV table content.

findings.recommended_validation: Focused isolated UI/IPC regression for the described scenario.

findings.title: HTML PDF failure blocks independent original/text choices
findings.user_visible_scenario: PDF conversion times out while user wants Original or Markdown.
findings.broken_or_incomplete_loop: Option enumeration eagerly awaits PDF, whose failure rejects all options; every selection repeats enumeration.
findings.minimal_repair_direction: Isolate failed option or convert lazily; preserve independently available original/text targets with localized retry for PDF.

existing_tests.assessment: Converter adapter tests do not cover enumeration/alternate selection after PDF failure.

findings.recommended_validation: Focused isolated UI/IPC regression for the described scenario.

findings.title: Branches can be selected but cannot be named or removed
findings.user_visible_scenario: Create alternate branches through edit/regenerate and manage them.
findings.broken_or_incomplete_loop: Fork/rename/delete backend and renderer clients exist; active Vue has selection/load-more only, unused fork/delete exports and short ID labels.
findings.minimal_repair_direction: Small reachable rename/fork/confirmed-delete menu with readable fallback labels, retaining backend safety.

existing_tests.assessment: Workspace tests cannot detect absent controls; existing branch tests cover selection/pagination.

findings.recommended_validation: Focused isolated UI/IPC regression for the described scenario.

findings.title: Cloud rule semantics and before/after changes are hidden
findings.user_visible_scenario: Inspect a Cloud rule before toggling it or review a candidate update.
findings.broken_or_incomplete_loop: Rule detail omits asserted value/target/selector/evidence; View Changes renders candidate only despite backend current+candidate data.
findings.minimal_repair_direction: Complete read-only semantic/evidence display and meaningful before/after rule change list.

existing_tests.assessment: Mocked tests verify calls but not readable assertion/target/evidence or removed/changed rules.

findings.recommended_validation: Focused isolated UI/IPC regression for the described scenario.

findings.title: Enabled attachment send-mode action always rejects
findings.user_visible_scenario: Click Default send mode in attachment Details.
findings.broken_or_incomplete_loop: UI enables preferredSendMode action, but mutation handler rejects every such update.
findings.minimal_repair_direction: Retire/disable obsolete V2 send-mode action instead of presenting a false setting; avoid adding a new authority without owner scope.

existing_tests.assessment: Attachment tests cover import/select/preview/remove, not send-mode mutation.

findings.recommended_validation: Focused isolated UI/IPC regression for the described scenario.

findings.title: Search/picker/attachment dialogs lack consistent focus and modal semantics
findings.user_visible_scenario: Keyboard-open Search/Details or tab past picker controls.
findings.broken_or_incomplete_loop: Some surfaces do not place/restore focus; all three omit complete modal semantics/background exclusion and Tab containment. Picker already places/restores initial focus.

evidence.description: Plain overlay, no full focus/Escape contract
Existing reusable correct local focus contract

findings.minimal_repair_direction: Reuse consistent dialog role/name/aria-modal, focus placement/return, containment, Escape and background exclusion while preserving picker navigation.

existing_tests.assessment: SettingsModal focus tests apply only there; pointer smoke checks visibility, not these dialog keyboard contracts.

findings.recommended_validation: Focused isolated UI/IPC regression for the described scenario.

findings.title: Search/manual-provider workflows ignore selected language
findings.user_visible_scenario: Use Chinese locale then open Search or manual compatible-provider/profile configuration.
findings.broken_or_incomplete_loop: Translated entry opens hardcoded English form/filters/results/loading/empty/rebuild or unlabeled mixed-language fields; scanner permits blanket component exclusions/threshold.
findings.minimal_repair_direction: Translate full workflows in both locales, associated labels and display choices; keep wire IDs stable, replace broad suppression with narrow valid exceptions.

existing_tests.assessment: Existing English-placeholder tests accept state; i18n parity PASS and 46-candidate tolerated scan do not prove translated UI.

findings.recommended_validation: Focused isolated UI/IPC regression for the described scenario.

findings.title: Settings fixtures validate retired/permissive authority instead of production closure
findings.user_visible_scenario: A shipped setting silently fails while nominal UI tests remain green.
findings.broken_or_incomplete_loop: Settings fixture supplies retired dbBridge and unrestricted store; main key rejection and UI caller are tested separately, not together.

evidence.description: Default smoke is seeded Markdown rather than Settings

findings.minimal_repair_direction: Add targeted acceptance using actual exposed bridge shape and production validation, plus isolated save/read-back/restart. Update only fixtures needed by repaired controls; do not refactor all tests.

existing_tests.assessment: Fixture fidelity hides absent bridge/unauthorized key and false ack; specialized DOCX coverage exists separately.

findings.recommended_validation: Settings save using real store IPC validation plus false/rejected ack; isolated preload/read-back acceptance.
findings.coordinator_severity_note: MEDIUM cross-cutting test gap; user-visible HIGH/BLOCKER defects are separately ranked to avoid duplicate impact.

findings.title: Active maintainer guardrails mandate retired send authority
findings.user_visible_scenario: A contributor repairing attachments follows active SSOT guidance toward an unreachable legacy path.
findings.broken_or_incomplete_loop: Mandatory docs name old serializer/sendPlan.buildCurrent authority while current sends use scoped Generation V2 commands and main compiler; legacy client still requires absent dbBridge.
findings.minimal_repair_direction: Narrow docs-only correction of active authority and regression pointers; preserve containment/non-goals, mark historical paths after checking consumers. No broad code deletion.

existing_tests.assessment: Current static authority gates pass but do not reconcile these active documentation claims.

findings.recommended_validation: Cross-document path/symbol consistency against current command→compiler path; docs gate as appropriate after a separate authorized docs repair.
